report.text:
# Go record update optimization

The existing `RecordAffineLoops` optimization already collapses the positive-count record-update loops into scalar arithmetic. The measured record-set bottleneck is repeated boxed-field lookup: large's action reads sixteen fields when converting its opaque input into a native record, then reads those sixteen fields again when consuming the unchanged original. `RecordGet` searches `RecordData.Keys` linearly.

This step changes only `GoConversions.unboxRecord`. For native target records with more than five fields, all represented by int64 and with unique labels, the conversion first checks that the boxed input is a non-null `TypeRecordData`, its complete key count matches, its value array is long enough, and every key matches the target field at that position. Only then are the integer payloads copied by position into the existing fresh native result. The whole shape check happens anew on each conversion.

TAST supplies the target record fields and scalar types. It does not establish the layout of an opaque or foreign value; the runtime guard proves that separately. Full unique-key agreement preserves first-match behavior for duplicate labels. Reordered, additional, missing or duplicate keys, maps, compact records, constructors, getters and other representations retain the original ordered `RecordGet` conversions. Composite or non-integer fields do not receive the guard. Integer payload reads cannot invoke a getter or mutate another field while copying.

The threshold follows `boxRecord`'s existing protocol: zero through five fields have compact layouts; larger records use `RecordData`. A compact-two-field diagnostic found a small extra-branch cost, so the compact path remains unchanged. No compiler usage annotation is used as an ownership proof. The source record is never mutated, no view is cached across calls, and no read is moved across a callback/effect. The second set of field reads remains unchanged and is a possible later optimization.

An isolated probe kept the actual emitted affine update worker and used an opaque runtime count and source values. Full-shape validation for the first conversion reduced the diagnostic action from approximately 388 ns to 182 ns. This identifies a plausible gain, not the official result; the benchmark campaign must compare against the frozen README baseline. Diagnostic slot-label-only variants were rejected because they do not preserve earlier duplicate keys.

Validation includes generated Go across 1/2/3/5/8/16-field records, canonical and reversed shapes, extra/duplicate/missing labels, short value arrays, compact/dynamic/foreign representations, constructor getter order, failures, one-time input evaluation and changed keys between calls. Related record regression tests passed 39/39. Benchmark code, FFI libraries, runtime implementation and C references are unchanged.

Benchmarks, harnesses, library FFI and C references are unchanged. Runtime inputs remain opaque.

This step optimizes conversion from boxed records to native structs. The separate field reads used to sum the original record remain unchanged and remain part of the measured work.

## Reference workloads

| Case | Official Go baseline (µs) | Paired before (µs) | After (µs) | Speedup in this pair |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| `record/set-small-1000` | 0.040 | 0.040 | 0.040 | 0.98× |
| `record/set-medium-1000` | 0.13 | 0.13 | 0.086 | 1.54× |
| `record/set-large-1000` | 0.36 | 0.37 | 0.21 | 1.76× |

## All 37 matched Go/C cases

| Indicator | Official baseline | Paired before | After |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Ratio of totals | 1.11× | 1.10× | 1.10× |
| Arithmetic mean μ | 27.60× | 27.74× | 23.29× |
| Median Q₂ | 5.91× | 5.87× | 5.91× |
| Geometric mean G | 6.66× | 6.61× | 6.42× |

All four indicators use the same 37 measured Go/C pairs: 14 core medians from App and 23 library medians from AppAll. The C denominator remains frozen at 8.777346938669927 ms. Differences between the official baseline and the fresh before measurement reflect measurement variation, not this compiler change.

## Measurement and validation

Three independent processes per build, in AB/BA/AB order; three global warm-ups, three local warm-ups, calibrated batches and the minimum of ten batches per process. Published rows use medians across the three processes. Release Go, GOGC=800, default GOMAXPROCS, no PGO. All builds and tests finish before measurement. The host is not isolated.

The App/AppAll campaign validates 306 measured outputs. Source and binary hashes are checked around each collection. The archived validation summary and runtime-input proofs record the targeted tests, varied inputs, repeatability and opaque-call checks.

Full commands, original outputs, compiler changes, input proofs and validation logs are preserved in [the JSON archive](2026-11-26-go-record-set.json) and `var/benchmark/go-record-set-20261126`.

## Regression review

No published case increased by more than 5% in the primary pair.

The medium and large record workloads improved by 1.5439× and 1.7641× respectively in the paired measurement. The small workload uses byte-identical generated code; its timing increased from 0.039537 to 0.040402 µs (+2.188%) and is retained as measured.

Across the 37 primary pairs, the total increased from 9.622728824 to 9.692447831 ms (+0.7245%), and the median Go/C ratio increased from 5.869695 to 5.908559 (+0.6621%). Neither indicator improved in this pair. The arithmetic mean decreased from 27.742516 to 23.291294, and the geometric mean from 6.608798 to 6.416601. These paired changes are distinguished from comparison with the official historical column; no overall measured speedup is claimed.

The core benchmark modules, harness and runtime are byte-identical. Core generated code as a whole is not identical: `Control_Bind.go` also gains the canonical projection for a seven-field date/time record (`day`, `hour`, `millisecond`, `minute`, `month`, `second`, `year`), with its previous fallback retained. AppAll adds that same change plus the medium and large record coercions. The observed small, total and median differences are retained without attributing their cause to the record-coercion change. No separate diagnostic timing was needed because no primary case increased by more than 5%.

Runtime input validation covers five record representations, including the exact boxed values produced by the original prepares, varied Int32 fields, repeated actions, and counts from 0 to 65,535. Input fields and keys remain unchanged. Negative counters are not claimed as exhaustively executed oracles: their original decrementing loops can require billions of iterations. The optimization changes record projection and preserves the existing update-loop behavior.

The compiler build retained one pre-existing warning in `PrivateSTRegions.purs` at line 266. The validation summary records the warning and verifies that this source file is unchanged from the frozen baseline.

module Gopurs.GoConversions
  ( module NativeAdts
  , coerceGoExpr
  , boxGoExpr
  , unboxGoExpr
  , generateReboxFunctions
  ) where

import Prelude

import Data.Array as Array
import Data.Map as Map
import Data.Maybe (Maybe(..), fromMaybe)
import Data.String as String
import Data.String.CodeUnits as CodeUnits
import Data.String.Pattern (Pattern(..))
import Data.Traversable (sequence)
import Data.Tuple (Tuple(..))
import Effect (Effect)
import Effect.Ref (Ref)
import Gopurs.CodegenState (CodegenMetadata, CodegenState)
import Gopurs.GoAst (rawGo, GoExpr(..), GoDecl, GoType(..), StructPointer, goTypeToStr, structPointer, recordFieldName)
import Gopurs.GoConversions.NativeAdts (UnboxedADT, unboxableADTs, getUnboxedADT, adtPayloadTypes) as NativeAdts
import Gopurs.GoConversions.NativeAdts (slotType)
import Gopurs.GoConversions.Rebox as Rebox
import Gopurs.Printer (printGoExpr)
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.FfiSupport (hashString)

-- Select a conversion before crossing Value. Record projection, native ADT
-- slots and same-constructor pointers have their own representation contracts.
coerceGoExpr :: Ref CodegenState -> String -> GoExpr -> GoType -> GoType -> GoExpr
coerceGoExpr _ _ expr from to | from == to = expr
coerceGoExpr stateRef moduleName expr (TypeRecord sourceFields) (TypeRecord targetFields)
  | canProjectRecord sourceFields targetFields =
      projectRecord (coerceGoExpr stateRef moduleName) expr sourceFields targetFields
coerceGoExpr stateRef moduleName expr source target@(TypeStructValue adtName fields) = case expr, source of
  GoConstructor _ structName typeArgs args, TypeStructPointer pointer | pointer.fullName == adtName ->
    let
      parts = String.split (Pattern "_") structName.name
      ctorName = fromMaybe "" (Array.last parts)
    in
      case Map.lookup adtName NativeAdts.unboxableADTs of
        Just adt ->
          let
            -- fieldIndex uses the canonical constructor identity; the short
            -- name belongs to mapConstructor, which also preserves sum tags.
            converted = sequence (Array.mapWithIndex (\i arg -> do
              slot <- adt.fieldIndex pointer.baseStructName i
              pure (coerceGoExpr stateRef moduleName arg (slotType typeArgs slot) (slotType fields slot))) args)
          in
            case converted of
              Just constructorFields -> GoStructValue adtName fields (adt.mapConstructor fields ctorName constructorFields)
              Nothing -> fallback unit
        Nothing -> fallback unit
  _, _ -> fallback unit
  where
  fallback _ = unboxGoExpr stateRef moduleName (boxGoExpr stateRef moduleName expr source) TypeValue target
-- Pointer identity ignores the PureScript fullName when the instantiated Go
-- layout and runtime tag are already identical.
coerceGoExpr _ _ expr (TypeStructPointer source) (TypeStructPointer target)
  | source.baseStructName == target.baseStructName && source.fullPath == target.fullPath && source.typeArgs == target.typeArgs = expr
coerceGoExpr stateRef moduleName expr (TypeStructPointer source) (TypeStructPointer target)
  | source.baseStructName == target.baseStructName = Rebox.request stateRef moduleName expr source target
coerceGoExpr stateRef moduleName expr source@(TypeStructPointer _) target@(TypeStructPointer _) =
  unboxGoExpr stateRef moduleName (boxGoExpr stateRef moduleName expr source) TypeValue target

-- Boxed generic pointers carry Value payloads. Rebox fields before boxing, or
-- read that erased layout first and Rebox afterwards when recovering a pointer.
coerceGoExpr stateRef moduleName expr source@(TypeStructPointer pointer) TypeValue | hasTypedArguments pointer =
  let target = boxedPointerType pointer
  in boxGoExpr stateRef moduleName (coerceGoExpr stateRef moduleName expr source target) target
coerceGoExpr stateRef moduleName expr TypeValue target@(TypeStructPointer pointer) | hasTypedArguments pointer =
  let source = boxedPointerType pointer
  in coerceGoExpr stateRef moduleName (unboxGoExpr stateRef moduleName expr TypeValue source) source target
coerceGoExpr stateRef moduleName expr source@(TypeStructValue sourceAdt _) target@(TypeStructPointer { fullName: targetAdt }) | sourceAdt == targetAdt =
  -- Native sums also box to Value payloads. Use the coercion above, rather
  -- than interpreting those fields directly as the target's typed arguments.
  coerceGoExpr stateRef moduleName (boxGoExpr stateRef moduleName expr source) TypeValue target
coerceGoExpr stateRef moduleName expr from TypeValue = boxGoExpr stateRef moduleName expr from
coerceGoExpr stateRef moduleName expr TypeValue to = unboxGoExpr stateRef moduleName expr TypeValue to
coerceGoExpr stateRef moduleName expr from to =
  unboxGoExpr stateRef moduleName (boxGoExpr stateRef moduleName expr from) TypeValue to

hasTypedArguments :: StructPointer -> Boolean
hasTypedArguments pointer = Array.any (_ /= TypeValue) pointer.typeArgs

boxedPointerType :: StructPointer -> GoType
boxedPointerType pointer = structPointer pointer (map (const TypeValue) pointer.typeArgs)

canProjectRecord :: Array (Tuple String GoType) -> Array (Tuple String GoType) -> Boolean
canProjectRecord sourceFields targetFields =
  let sourceTypes = Map.fromFoldable sourceFields
  in Array.all (\(Tuple key _) -> Map.member key sourceTypes) targetFields

-- Evaluate the whole source once, including extra fields the worker drops.
projectRecord :: (GoExpr -> GoType -> GoType -> GoExpr) -> GoExpr -> Array (Tuple String GoType) -> Array (Tuple String GoType) -> GoExpr
projectRecord coerceField expr sourceFields targetFields =
  let
    sourceTypes = Map.fromFoldable sourceFields
    target = TypeRecord targetFields
    fields = map
      (\(Tuple key targetType) -> Tuple key
        (coerceField (GoRecordFieldAccess (GoVar "record") key)
          (fromMaybe TypeValue (Map.lookup key sourceTypes)) targetType))
      targetFields
  in
    GoCall (GoFuncLit [ Tuple "record" (TypeRecord sourceFields) ] [] (GoRecordDict target fields) target) [ expr ]

-- Normalize generic pointer payloads before emitting the box itself. Keeping
-- this step outside boxNativeExpr prevents repeated Rebox requests.
boxGoExpr :: Ref CodegenState -> String -> GoExpr -> GoType -> GoExpr
boxGoExpr stateRef moduleName expr source@(TypeStructPointer pointer) | hasTypedArguments pointer =
  coerceGoExpr stateRef moduleName expr source TypeValue
boxGoExpr stateRef moduleName expr source = boxNativeExpr stateRef moduleName expr source

boxNativeExpr :: Ref CodegenState -> String -> GoExpr -> GoType -> GoExpr
boxNativeExpr _ _ expr TypeValue = expr
boxNativeExpr _ _ expr TypeInt64 = GoCall (GoSelector (GoVar "gopurs_runtime") "Int") [ expr ]
boxNativeExpr _ _ expr TypeFloat64 = GoCall (GoSelector (GoVar "gopurs_runtime") "Float") [ expr ]
boxNativeExpr _ _ expr TypeString = boxStringExpr expr
boxNativeExpr _ _ expr TypeBool = GoCall (GoSelector (GoVar "gopurs_runtime") "Bool") [ expr ]
boxNativeExpr _ _ expr (TypeStructPointer { baseStructName }) = GoBoxStructPointer (hashString baseStructName) expr
boxNativeExpr stateRef moduleName expr (TypeRecord fields) = boxRecord (boxGoExpr stateRef moduleName) expr fields
boxNativeExpr _ _ expr (TypeInterface _) = expr
boxNativeExpr _ _ expr (TypeNamed _) = GoCall (GoSelector (GoVar "gopurs_runtime") "Box") [ expr ]
boxNativeExpr _ _ expr (TypePointer _) = GoCall (GoSelector (GoVar "gopurs_runtime") "Box") [ expr ]
boxNativeExpr _ _ expr (TypeNativeArray TypeValue) = boxValueArray expr
boxNativeExpr _ _ expr (TypeNativeArray TypeInt64) = boxIntArray expr
boxNativeExpr stateRef moduleName expr (TypeNativeArray inner) = boxArray (boxGoExpr stateRef moduleName) expr inner
boxNativeExpr _ _ expr TypeUint32 = rawGo ("gopurs_runtime.Value{Type: 9, IntVal: int64(" <> printGoExpr expr <> "), UnsafePtr: nil}")
boxNativeExpr _ _ expr (TypeGenericParam _) = expr
boxNativeExpr _ _ expr (TypeFunc _ _) = expr
-- Multiple results describe declarations, never a boxed PureScript value.
boxNativeExpr _ _ _ (TypeResults _) = rawGo "func() gopurs_runtime.Value { panic(\"cannot box multiple Go results\") }()"
boxNativeExpr stateRef moduleName expr (TypeStructValue adtName fields) =
  case Map.lookup adtName NativeAdts.unboxableADTs of
    Just adt -> adt.boxExpr (boxGoExpr stateRef moduleName) fields expr
    Nothing -> rawGo ("func() gopurs_runtime.Value {\n\t\t\t\t_ = " <> printGoExpr expr <> "\n\t\t\t\tpanic(\"boxTypeStructValue not implemented yet for " <> adtName <> "\")\n\t\t\t}()")

-- These identity conversions retain optional immutable string metadata. A
-- genuinely native string still uses the ordinary constant-time Str box.
boxStringExpr :: GoExpr -> GoExpr
boxStringExpr expr = case expr of
  GoCall (GoSelector source "StrVal") [] ->
    GoCall (GoSelector (GoVar "gopurs_runtime") "NormalizeStringValue") [ source ]
  GoString literal ->
    GoCall (GoSelector (GoVar "gopurs_runtime") "StrWithCodeUnits") [ expr, GoInt (CodeUnits.length literal) ]
  _ -> GoCall (GoSelector (GoVar "gopurs_runtime") "Str") [ expr ]

-- Normalize the source to Value once. The destination reader below never sees
-- a native source; typed pointer payload adaptation belongs to coerceGoExpr.
unboxGoExpr :: Ref CodegenState -> String -> GoExpr -> GoType -> GoType -> GoExpr
unboxGoExpr stateRef moduleName expr currentType desiredType
  | currentType == desiredType = expr
  | currentType /= TypeValue =
      unboxValue stateRef moduleName (boxGoExpr stateRef moduleName expr currentType) desiredType
  | otherwise = unboxValue stateRef moduleName expr desiredType

unboxValue :: Ref CodegenState -> String -> GoExpr -> GoType -> GoExpr
unboxValue stateRef moduleName expr desiredType = case desiredType of
  TypeValue -> expr
  TypeRecord fields -> unboxRecord (coerceGoExpr stateRef moduleName) expr fields
  TypeInt64 -> GoSelector expr "IntVal"
  TypeFloat64 -> GoCall (GoSelector expr "FloatVal") []
  TypeString -> GoCall (GoSelector expr "StrVal") []
  TypeBool -> GoBinOp "!=" (GoSelector expr "IntVal") (GoInt 0)
  TypeUint32 -> rawGo ("uint32(" <> printGoExpr (GoSelector expr "IntVal") <> ")")
  TypeStructPointer { fullPath } -> GoCall (rawGo ("gopurs_runtime.CoerceToStruct[" <> fullPath <> "]")) [ expr ]
  TypeInterface _ -> expr
  TypeNamed _ -> GoCall (GoTypeApply (GoSelector (GoVar "gopurs_runtime") "Unbox") [ desiredType ]) [ expr ]
  TypePointer _ -> GoCall (GoTypeApply (GoSelector (GoVar "gopurs_runtime") "Unbox") [ desiredType ]) [ expr ]
  -- Value arrays borrow their immutable slice; boxing []Value also shares it.
  TypeNativeArray TypeValue -> GoPrefixOp "*"
    (GoCall (rawGo "(*[]gopurs_runtime.Value)") [ GoSelector expr "UnsafePtr" ])
  TypeNativeArray TypeInt64 -> case expr of
    GoBoxIntArray source -> GoCall copyIntArray [ source ]
    _ -> GoUnboxIntArray expr
  TypeNativeArray inner -> unboxArray (coerceGoExpr stateRef moduleName) expr inner
  TypeGenericParam _ -> expr
  -- Structurally admitted Int-list filters request this one callback ABI.
  -- Capture an opaque boxed producer once, even for empty input; each element
  -- still invokes the original callback through its ordinary runtime entry.
  TypeFunc [ TypeInt64 ] TypeBool ->
    GoCall (GoFuncLit [ Tuple "boxedPredicate" TypeValue ] []
      (GoFuncLit [ Tuple "predicateInput" TypeInt64 ] []
        (GoBinOp "!="
          (GoSelector (GoCall (GoSelector (GoVar "gopurs_runtime") "Apply")
            [ GoVar "boxedPredicate", GoCall (GoSelector (GoVar "gopurs_runtime") "Int") [ GoVar "predicateInput" ] ]) "IntVal")
          (GoInt 0)) TypeBool)
      (TypeFunc [ TypeInt64 ] TypeBool)) [ expr ]
  TypeFunc _ _ -> expr
  TypeResults _ -> rawGo ("func() " <> goTypeToStr desiredType <> " { panic(\"cannot unbox multiple Go results\") }()")
  TypeStructValue adtName fields ->
    case Map.lookup adtName NativeAdts.unboxableADTs of
      Just adt -> adt.unboxExpr (\value fieldType -> unboxGoExpr stateRef moduleName value TypeValue fieldType) fields expr
      Nothing -> rawGo ("func() " <> goTypeToStr desiredType <> " {\n\t\t\t\t_ = " <> printGoExpr expr <> "\n\t\t\t\tpanic(\"unboxTypeStructValue not implemented yet for " <> adtName <> "\")\n\t\t\t}()")

-- Array/extract only changes the slice header when its operand is already a
-- proven runtime Array. Unknown Values retain the original tag normalization.
boxValueArray :: GoExpr -> GoExpr
boxValueArray expression = case expression of
  GoPrefixOp "*" (GoCall cast [ GoSelector source "UnsafePtr" ])
    | cast == rawGo "(*[]gopurs_runtime.Value)" && constructedArray source -> source
  _ -> GoCall (GoSelector (GoVar "gopurs_runtime") "Array") [ expression ]
  where
  constructedArray (GoBoxIntArray _) = true
  constructedArray (GoCall (GoSelector (GoVar "gopurs_runtime") "Array") [ _ ]) = true
  constructedArray _ = false

-- Int(v).IntVal is exactly v, including values outside Int32. The roundtrip
-- still returns fresh storage: a native copy replaces the two element buffers.
-- Use make/copy instead of slices.Clone so nil inputs still yield nonnil [].
copyIntArray :: GoExpr
copyIntArray = GoFuncLit [ Tuple "arrayCopy_input" (TypeNativeArray TypeInt64) ]
  [ GoAssign "arrayCopy_output" (GoCall (GoVar "make")
      [ rawGo "[]int64", GoCall (GoVar "len") [ GoVar "arrayCopy_input" ] ])
  , GoCall (GoVar "copy") [ GoVar "arrayCopy_output", GoVar "arrayCopy_input" ]
  ] (GoVar "arrayCopy_output") (TypeNativeArray TypeInt64)

boxIntArray :: GoExpr -> GoExpr
boxIntArray expression = case expression of
  -- The final box itself copies every scalar into a fresh Value buffer; an
  -- immediately preceding private copy cannot be observed. No variables,
  -- stored values or arbitrary calls are searched through for this identity.
  GoCall copier [ source ] | copier == copyIntArray -> GoBoxIntArray source
  _ -> GoBoxIntArray expression

-- Records and arrays capture their operand once, then adapt fields/elements in
-- source order. These callbacks can register Rebox dependencies recursively.
boxRecord :: (GoExpr -> GoType -> GoExpr) -> GoExpr -> Array (Tuple String GoType) -> GoExpr
boxRecord boxField expr fields =
  let
    keys = map (\(Tuple key _) -> key) fields
    keysStr = String.joinWith ", " (map (printGoExpr <<< GoString) keys)
    valsStr = String.joinWith ", " (map (\(Tuple key fieldType) -> printGoExpr (boxField (GoStructAccess (GoVar "orig") (recordFieldName key)) fieldType)) fields)
    boxedRecord = case Array.length fields of
      0 -> "gopurs_runtime.RecordDict0()"
      size | size <= 5 -> "gopurs_runtime.RecordDict" <> show size <> "(" <> keysStr <> ", " <> valsStr <> ")"
      _ -> "gopurs_runtime.RecordDict([]string{" <> keysStr <> "}, []gopurs_runtime.Value{" <> valsStr <> "})"
  in
    rawGo ("func() gopurs_runtime.Value {\n\t\t\t\torig := " <> printGoExpr expr <> "\n\t\t\t\t_ = orig\n\t\t\t\treturn " <> boxedRecord <> "\n\t\t\t\t}()")

unboxRecord :: (GoExpr -> GoType -> GoType -> GoExpr) -> GoExpr -> Array (Tuple String GoType) -> GoExpr
unboxRecord coerceField expr fields =
  let
    recordType = goTypeToStr (TypeRecord fields)
    assignments = String.joinWith "\n" (map (\(Tuple key fieldType) -> "\t\t\t\t\tclone." <> recordFieldName key <> " = " <> printGoExpr (coerceField (GoCall (GoSelector (GoVar "gopurs_runtime") "RecordGet") [ GoVar "orig", GoString key ]) TypeValue fieldType)) fields)
  in
    rawGo ("func() " <> recordType <> " {\n\t\t\t\t\torig := " <> printGoExpr expr <> "\n\t\t\t\t\t_ = orig\n\t\t\t\t\tclone := " <> recordType <> "{}\n" <> assignments <> "\n\t\t\t\t\treturn clone\n\t\t\t\t}()")

boxArray :: (GoExpr -> GoType -> GoExpr) -> GoExpr -> GoType -> GoExpr
boxArray boxElement expr inner =
  rawGo ("func() gopurs_runtime.Value {\n\t\t\t\t\tarr := " <> printGoExpr expr <> "\n\t\t\t\t\tboxed := make([]gopurs_runtime.Value, len(arr))\n\t\t\t\t\tfor i, v := range arr { boxed[i] = " <> printGoExpr (boxElement (GoVar "v") inner) <> " }\n\t\t\t\t\treturn gopurs_runtime.Array(boxed)\n\t\t\t\t}()")

unboxArray :: (GoExpr -> GoType -> GoType -> GoExpr) -> GoExpr -> GoType -> GoExpr
unboxArray coerceElement expr inner =
  let arrayType = goTypeToStr (TypeNativeArray inner)
  in rawGo ("func() " <> arrayType <> " {\n\t\t\t\t\tarr := *(*[]gopurs_runtime.Value)(" <> printGoExpr expr <> ".UnsafePtr)\n\t\t\t\t\tunboxed := make(" <> arrayType <> ", len(arr))\n\t\t\t\t\tfor i, v := range arr { unboxed[i] = " <> printGoExpr (coerceElement (GoVar "v") TypeValue inner) <> " }\n\t\t\t\t\treturn unboxed\n\t\t\t\t}()")

-- Field rendering re-enters this converter with the same module-local state.
-- Rebox owns request tracking, naming and the transitive emission loop.
generateReboxFunctions :: CodegenMetadata -> Ref CodegenState -> String -> Effect (Array GoDecl)
generateReboxFunctions metadata stateRef moduleName =
  Rebox.generate metadata stateRef moduleName (coerceGoExpr stateRef moduleName)

module Gopurs.GoConversions
  ( module NativeAdts
  , coerceGoExpr
  , boxGoExpr
  , unboxGoExpr
  , generateReboxFunctions
  ) where

import Prelude

import Data.Array as Array
import Data.Map as Map
import Data.Maybe (Maybe(..), fromMaybe)
import Data.String as String
import Data.String.CodeUnits as CodeUnits
import Data.String.Pattern (Pattern(..))
import Data.Traversable (sequence)
import Data.Tuple (Tuple(..))
import Effect (Effect)
import Effect.Ref (Ref)
import Gopurs.CodegenState (CodegenMetadata, CodegenState)
import Gopurs.GoAst (rawGo, GoExpr(..), GoDecl, GoType(..), StructPointer, goTypeToStr, structPointer, recordFieldName)
import Gopurs.GoConversions.NativeAdts (UnboxedADT, unboxableADTs, getUnboxedADT, adtPayloadTypes) as NativeAdts
import Gopurs.GoConversions.NativeAdts (slotType)
import Gopurs.GoConversions.Rebox as Rebox
import Gopurs.Printer (printGoExpr)
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.FfiSupport (hashString)

-- Select a conversion before crossing Value. Record projection, native ADT
-- slots and same-constructor pointers have their own representation contracts.
coerceGoExpr :: Ref CodegenState -> String -> GoExpr -> GoType -> GoType -> GoExpr
coerceGoExpr _ _ expr from to | from == to = expr
coerceGoExpr stateRef moduleName expr (TypeRecord sourceFields) (TypeRecord targetFields)
  | canProjectRecord sourceFields targetFields =
      projectRecord (coerceGoExpr stateRef moduleName) expr sourceFields targetFields
coerceGoExpr stateRef moduleName expr source target@(TypeStructValue adtName fields) = case expr, source of
  GoConstructor _ structName typeArgs args, TypeStructPointer pointer | pointer.fullName == adtName ->
    let
      parts = String.split (Pattern "_") structName.name
      ctorName = fromMaybe "" (Array.last parts)
    in
      case Map.lookup adtName NativeAdts.unboxableADTs of
        Just adt ->
          let
            -- fieldIndex uses the canonical constructor identity; the short
            -- name belongs to mapConstructor, which also preserves sum tags.
            converted = sequence (Array.mapWithIndex (\i arg -> do
              slot <- adt.fieldIndex pointer.baseStructName i
              pure (coerceGoExpr stateRef moduleName arg (slotType typeArgs slot) (slotType fields slot))) args)
          in
            case converted of
              Just constructorFields -> GoStructValue adtName fields (adt.mapConstructor fields ctorName constructorFields)
              Nothing -> fallback unit
        Nothing -> fallback unit
  _, _ -> fallback unit
  where
  fallback _ = unboxGoExpr stateRef moduleName (boxGoExpr stateRef moduleName expr source) TypeValue target
-- Pointer identity ignores the PureScript fullName when the instantiated Go
-- layout and runtime tag are already identical.
coerceGoExpr _ _ expr (TypeStructPointer source) (TypeStructPointer target)
  | source.baseStructName == target.baseStructName && source.fullPath == target.fullPath && source.typeArgs == target.typeArgs = expr
coerceGoExpr stateRef moduleName expr (TypeStructPointer source) (TypeStructPointer target)
  | source.baseStructName == target.baseStructName = Rebox.request stateRef moduleName expr source target
coerceGoExpr stateRef moduleName expr source@(TypeStructPointer _) target@(TypeStructPointer _) =
  unboxGoExpr stateRef moduleName (boxGoExpr stateRef moduleName expr source) TypeValue target

-- Boxed generic pointers carry Value payloads. Rebox fields before boxing, or
-- read that erased layout first and Rebox afterwards when recovering a pointer.
coerceGoExpr stateRef moduleName expr source@(TypeStructPointer pointer) TypeValue | hasTypedArguments pointer =
  let target = boxedPointerType pointer
  in boxGoExpr stateRef moduleName (coerceGoExpr stateRef moduleName expr source target) target
coerceGoExpr stateRef moduleName expr TypeValue target@(TypeStructPointer pointer) | hasTypedArguments pointer =
  let source = boxedPointerType pointer
  in coerceGoExpr stateRef moduleName (unboxGoExpr stateRef moduleName expr TypeValue source) source target
coerceGoExpr stateRef moduleName expr source@(TypeStructValue sourceAdt _) target@(TypeStructPointer { fullName: targetAdt }) | sourceAdt == targetAdt =
  -- Native sums also box to Value payloads. Use the coercion above, rather
  -- than interpreting those fields directly as the target's typed arguments.
  coerceGoExpr stateRef moduleName (boxGoExpr stateRef moduleName expr source) TypeValue target
coerceGoExpr stateRef moduleName expr from TypeValue = boxGoExpr stateRef moduleName expr from
coerceGoExpr stateRef moduleName expr TypeValue to = unboxGoExpr stateRef moduleName expr TypeValue to
coerceGoExpr stateRef moduleName expr from to =
  unboxGoExpr stateRef moduleName (boxGoExpr stateRef moduleName expr from) TypeValue to

hasTypedArguments :: StructPointer -> Boolean
hasTypedArguments pointer = Array.any (_ /= TypeValue) pointer.typeArgs

boxedPointerType :: StructPointer -> GoType
boxedPointerType pointer = structPointer pointer (map (const TypeValue) pointer.typeArgs)

canProjectRecord :: Array (Tuple String GoType) -> Array (Tuple String GoType) -> Boolean
canProjectRecord sourceFields targetFields =
  let sourceTypes = Map.fromFoldable sourceFields
  in Array.all (\(Tuple key _) -> Map.member key sourceTypes) targetFields

-- Evaluate the whole source once, including extra fields the worker drops.
projectRecord :: (GoExpr -> GoType -> GoType -> GoExpr) -> GoExpr -> Array (Tuple String GoType) -> Array (Tuple String GoType) -> GoExpr
projectRecord coerceField expr sourceFields targetFields =
  let
    sourceTypes = Map.fromFoldable sourceFields
    target = TypeRecord targetFields
    fields = map
      (\(Tuple key targetType) -> Tuple key
        (coerceField (GoRecordFieldAccess (GoVar "record") key)
          (fromMaybe TypeValue (Map.lookup key sourceTypes)) targetType))
      targetFields
  in
    GoCall (GoFuncLit [ Tuple "record" (TypeRecord sourceFields) ] [] (GoRecordDict target fields) target) [ expr ]

-- Normalize generic pointer payloads before emitting the box itself. Keeping
-- this step outside boxNativeExpr prevents repeated Rebox requests.
boxGoExpr :: Ref CodegenState -> String -> GoExpr -> GoType -> GoExpr
boxGoExpr stateRef moduleName expr source@(TypeStructPointer pointer) | hasTypedArguments pointer =
  coerceGoExpr stateRef moduleName expr source TypeValue
boxGoExpr stateRef moduleName expr source = boxNativeExpr stateRef moduleName expr source

boxNativeExpr :: Ref CodegenState -> String -> GoExpr -> GoType -> GoExpr
boxNativeExpr _ _ expr TypeValue = expr
boxNativeExpr _ _ expr TypeInt64 = GoCall (GoSelector (GoVar "gopurs_runtime") "Int") [ expr ]
boxNativeExpr _ _ expr TypeFloat64 = GoCall (GoSelector (GoVar "gopurs_runtime") "Float") [ expr ]
boxNativeExpr _ _ expr TypeString = boxStringExpr expr
boxNativeExpr _ _ expr TypeBool = GoCall (GoSelector (GoVar "gopurs_runtime") "Bool") [ expr ]
boxNativeExpr _ _ expr (TypeStructPointer { baseStructName }) = GoBoxStructPointer (hashString baseStructName) expr
boxNativeExpr stateRef moduleName expr (TypeRecord fields) = boxRecord (boxGoExpr stateRef moduleName) expr fields
boxNativeExpr _ _ expr (TypeInterface _) = expr
boxNativeExpr _ _ expr (TypeNamed _) = GoCall (GoSelector (GoVar "gopurs_runtime") "Box") [ expr ]
boxNativeExpr _ _ expr (TypePointer _) = GoCall (GoSelector (GoVar "gopurs_runtime") "Box") [ expr ]
boxNativeExpr _ _ expr (TypeNativeArray TypeValue) = boxValueArray expr
boxNativeExpr _ _ expr (TypeNativeArray TypeInt64) = boxIntArray expr
boxNativeExpr stateRef moduleName expr (TypeNativeArray inner) = boxArray (boxGoExpr stateRef moduleName) expr inner
boxNativeExpr _ _ expr TypeUint32 = rawGo ("gopurs_runtime.Value{Type: 9, IntVal: int64(" <> printGoExpr expr <> "), UnsafePtr: nil}")
boxNativeExpr _ _ expr (TypeGenericParam _) = expr
boxNativeExpr _ _ expr (TypeFunc _ _) = expr
-- Multiple results describe declarations, never a boxed PureScript value.
boxNativeExpr _ _ _ (TypeResults _) = rawGo "func() gopurs_runtime.Value { panic(\"cannot box multiple Go results\") }()"
boxNativeExpr stateRef moduleName expr (TypeStructValue adtName fields) =
  case Map.lookup adtName NativeAdts.unboxableADTs of
    Just adt -> adt.boxExpr (boxGoExpr stateRef moduleName) fields expr
    Nothing -> rawGo ("func() gopurs_runtime.Value {\n\t\t\t\t_ = " <> printGoExpr expr <> "\n\t\t\t\tpanic(\"boxTypeStructValue not implemented yet for " <> adtName <> "\")\n\t\t\t}()")

-- These identity conversions retain optional immutable string metadata. A
-- genuinely native string still uses the ordinary constant-time Str box.
boxStringExpr :: GoExpr -> GoExpr
boxStringExpr expr = case expr of
  GoCall (GoSelector source "StrVal") [] ->
    GoCall (GoSelector (GoVar "gopurs_runtime") "NormalizeStringValue") [ source ]
  GoString literal ->
    GoCall (GoSelector (GoVar "gopurs_runtime") "StrWithCodeUnits") [ expr, GoInt (CodeUnits.length literal) ]
  _ -> GoCall (GoSelector (GoVar "gopurs_runtime") "Str") [ expr ]

-- Normalize the source to Value once. The destination reader below never sees
-- a native source; typed pointer payload adaptation belongs to coerceGoExpr.
unboxGoExpr :: Ref CodegenState -> String -> GoExpr -> GoType -> GoType -> GoExpr
unboxGoExpr stateRef moduleName expr currentType desiredType
  | currentType == desiredType = expr
  | currentType /= TypeValue =
      unboxValue stateRef moduleName (boxGoExpr stateRef moduleName expr currentType) desiredType
  | otherwise = unboxValue stateRef moduleName expr desiredType

unboxValue :: Ref CodegenState -> String -> GoExpr -> GoType -> GoExpr
unboxValue stateRef moduleName expr desiredType = case desiredType of
  TypeValue -> expr
  TypeRecord fields -> unboxRecord (coerceGoExpr stateRef moduleName) expr fields
  TypeInt64 -> GoSelector expr "IntVal"
  TypeFloat64 -> GoCall (GoSelector expr "FloatVal") []
  TypeString -> GoCall (GoSelector expr "StrVal") []
  TypeBool -> GoBinOp "!=" (GoSelector expr "IntVal") (GoInt 0)
  TypeUint32 -> rawGo ("uint32(" <> printGoExpr (GoSelector expr "IntVal") <> ")")
  TypeStructPointer { fullPath } -> GoCall (rawGo ("gopurs_runtime.CoerceToStruct[" <> fullPath <> "]")) [ expr ]
  TypeInterface _ -> expr
  TypeNamed _ -> GoCall (GoTypeApply (GoSelector (GoVar "gopurs_runtime") "Unbox") [ desiredType ]) [ expr ]
  TypePointer _ -> GoCall (GoTypeApply (GoSelector (GoVar "gopurs_runtime") "Unbox") [ desiredType ]) [ expr ]
  -- Value arrays borrow their immutable slice; boxing []Value also shares it.
  TypeNativeArray TypeValue -> GoPrefixOp "*"
    (GoCall (rawGo "(*[]gopurs_runtime.Value)") [ GoSelector expr "UnsafePtr" ])
  TypeNativeArray TypeInt64 -> case expr of
    GoBoxIntArray source -> GoCall copyIntArray [ source ]
    _ -> GoUnboxIntArray expr
  TypeNativeArray inner -> unboxArray (coerceGoExpr stateRef moduleName) expr inner
  TypeGenericParam _ -> expr
  -- Structurally admitted Int-list filters request this one callback ABI.
  -- Capture an opaque boxed producer once, even for empty input; each element
  -- still invokes the original callback through its ordinary runtime entry.
  TypeFunc [ TypeInt64 ] TypeBool ->
    GoCall (GoFuncLit [ Tuple "boxedPredicate" TypeValue ] []
      (GoFuncLit [ Tuple "predicateInput" TypeInt64 ] []
        (GoBinOp "!="
          (GoSelector (GoCall (GoSelector (GoVar "gopurs_runtime") "Apply")
            [ GoVar "boxedPredicate", GoCall (GoSelector (GoVar "gopurs_runtime") "Int") [ GoVar "predicateInput" ] ]) "IntVal")
          (GoInt 0)) TypeBool)
      (TypeFunc [ TypeInt64 ] TypeBool)) [ expr ]
  TypeFunc _ _ -> expr
  TypeResults _ -> rawGo ("func() " <> goTypeToStr desiredType <> " { panic(\"cannot unbox multiple Go results\") }()")
  TypeStructValue adtName fields ->
    case Map.lookup adtName NativeAdts.unboxableADTs of
      Just adt -> adt.unboxExpr (\value fieldType -> unboxGoExpr stateRef moduleName value TypeValue fieldType) fields expr
      Nothing -> rawGo ("func() " <> goTypeToStr desiredType <> " {\n\t\t\t\t_ = " <> printGoExpr expr <> "\n\t\t\t\tpanic(\"unboxTypeStructValue not implemented yet for " <> adtName <> "\")\n\t\t\t}()")

-- Array/extract only changes the slice header when its operand is already a
-- proven runtime Array. Unknown Values retain the original tag normalization.
boxValueArray :: GoExpr -> GoExpr
boxValueArray expression = case expression of
  GoPrefixOp "*" (GoCall cast [ GoSelector source "UnsafePtr" ])
    | cast == rawGo "(*[]gopurs_runtime.Value)" && constructedArray source -> source
  _ -> GoCall (GoSelector (GoVar "gopurs_runtime") "Array") [ expression ]
  where
  constructedArray (GoBoxIntArray _) = true
  constructedArray (GoCall (GoSelector (GoVar "gopurs_runtime") "Array") [ _ ]) = true
  constructedArray _ = false

-- Int(v).IntVal is exactly v, including values outside Int32. The roundtrip
-- still returns fresh storage: a native copy replaces the two element buffers.
-- Use make/copy instead of slices.Clone so nil inputs still yield nonnil [].
copyIntArray :: GoExpr
copyIntArray = GoFuncLit [ Tuple "arrayCopy_input" (TypeNativeArray TypeInt64) ]
  [ GoAssign "arrayCopy_output" (GoCall (GoVar "make")
      [ rawGo "[]int64", GoCall (GoVar "len") [ GoVar "arrayCopy_input" ] ])
  , GoCall (GoVar "copy") [ GoVar "arrayCopy_output", GoVar "arrayCopy_input" ]
  ] (GoVar "arrayCopy_output") (TypeNativeArray TypeInt64)

boxIntArray :: GoExpr -> GoExpr
boxIntArray expression = case expression of
  -- The final box itself copies every scalar into a fresh Value buffer; an
  -- immediately preceding private copy cannot be observed. No variables,
  -- stored values or arbitrary calls are searched through for this identity.
  GoCall copier [ source ] | copier == copyIntArray -> GoBoxIntArray source
  _ -> GoBoxIntArray expression

-- Records and arrays capture their operand once, then adapt fields/elements in
-- source order. These callbacks can register Rebox dependencies recursively.
boxRecord :: (GoExpr -> GoType -> GoExpr) -> GoExpr -> Array (Tuple String GoType) -> GoExpr
boxRecord boxField expr fields =
  let
    keys = map (\(Tuple key _) -> key) fields
    keysStr = String.joinWith ", " (map (printGoExpr <<< GoString) keys)
    valsStr = String.joinWith ", " (map (\(Tuple key fieldType) -> printGoExpr (boxField (GoStructAccess (GoVar "orig") (recordFieldName key)) fieldType)) fields)
    boxedRecord = case Array.length fields of
      0 -> "gopurs_runtime.RecordDict0()"
      size | size <= 5 -> "gopurs_runtime.RecordDict" <> show size <> "(" <> keysStr <> ", " <> valsStr <> ")"
      _ -> "gopurs_runtime.RecordDict([]string{" <> keysStr <> "}, []gopurs_runtime.Value{" <> valsStr <> "})"
  in
    rawGo ("func() gopurs_runtime.Value {\n\t\t\t\torig := " <> printGoExpr expr <> "\n\t\t\t\t_ = orig\n\t\t\t\treturn " <> boxedRecord <> "\n\t\t\t\t}()")

unboxRecord :: (GoExpr -> GoType -> GoType -> GoExpr) -> GoExpr -> Array (Tuple String GoType) -> GoExpr
unboxRecord coerceField expr fields =
  let
    recordType = goTypeToStr (TypeRecord fields)
    assignments = String.joinWith "\n" (map (\(Tuple key fieldType) -> "\t\t\t\t\tclone." <> recordFieldName key <> " = " <> printGoExpr (coerceField (GoCall (GoSelector (GoVar "gopurs_runtime") "RecordGet") [ GoVar "orig", GoString key ]) TypeValue fieldType)) fields)
    keys = map (\(Tuple key _) -> key) fields
    -- TAST gives the target layout, not the layout of an opaque boxed value.
    -- Validate the complete runtime shape before using positions. Exact unique
    -- keys also preserve RecordGet's first-match semantics for duplicate keys.
    -- IntVal reads cannot call getters or mutate another field during copying;
    -- composite/foreign coercions retain their original ordered access path.
    -- boxRecord uses compact layouts for zero through five fields. Avoid
    -- adding a branch to those already small projections.
    guardedProjection = if Array.length fields > 5 && Array.length (Array.nub keys) == Array.length keys
      && Array.all (\(Tuple _ fieldType) -> fieldType == TypeInt64) fields then
      let
        count = show (Array.length fields)
        labels = String.joinWith " && " (Array.mapWithIndex
          (\index key -> "recordProjection_data.Keys[" <> show index <> "] == " <> printGoExpr (GoString key)) keys)
        copies = String.joinWith "\n" (Array.mapWithIndex (\index (Tuple key _) ->
          "clone." <> recordFieldName key <> " = recordProjection_data.Vals[" <> show index <> "].IntVal") fields)
      in
        "if orig.Type == gopurs_runtime.TypeRecordData && orig.UnsafePtr != nil {\n"
          <> "recordProjection_data := (*gopurs_runtime.RecordData)(orig.UnsafePtr)\n"
          <> "if len(recordProjection_data.Keys) == " <> count <> " && len(recordProjection_data.Vals) >= " <> count
          <> " && " <> labels <> " {\n" <> copies <> "\nreturn clone\n}\n}\n"
      else ""
  in
    rawGo ("func() " <> recordType <> " {\n\t\t\t\t\torig := " <> printGoExpr expr <> "\n\t\t\t\t\t_ = orig\n\t\t\t\t\tclone := " <> recordType <> "{}\n" <> guardedProjection <> assignments <> "\n\t\t\t\t\treturn clone\n\t\t\t\t}()")

boxArray :: (GoExpr -> GoType -> GoExpr) -> GoExpr -> GoType -> GoExpr
boxArray boxElement expr inner =
  rawGo ("func() gopurs_runtime.Value {\n\t\t\t\t\tarr := " <> printGoExpr expr <> "\n\t\t\t\t\tboxed := make([]gopurs_runtime.Value, len(arr))\n\t\t\t\t\tfor i, v := range arr { boxed[i] = " <> printGoExpr (boxElement (GoVar "v") inner) <> " }\n\t\t\t\t\treturn gopurs_runtime.Array(boxed)\n\t\t\t\t}()")

unboxArray :: (GoExpr -> GoType -> GoType -> GoExpr) -> GoExpr -> GoType -> GoExpr
unboxArray coerceElement expr inner =
  let arrayType = goTypeToStr (TypeNativeArray inner)
  in rawGo ("func() " <> arrayType <> " {\n\t\t\t\t\tarr := *(*[]gopurs_runtime.Value)(" <> printGoExpr expr <> ".UnsafePtr)\n\t\t\t\t\tunboxed := make(" <> arrayType <> ", len(arr))\n\t\t\t\t\tfor i, v := range arr { unboxed[i] = " <> printGoExpr (coerceElement (GoVar "v") TypeValue inner) <> " }\n\t\t\t\t\treturn unboxed\n\t\t\t\t}()")

-- Field rendering re-enters this converter with the same module-local state.
-- Rebox owns request tracking, naming and the transitive emission loop.
generateReboxFunctions :: CodegenMetadata -> Ref CodegenState -> String -> Effect (Array GoDecl)
generateReboxFunctions metadata stateRef moduleName =
  Rebox.generate metadata stateRef moduleName (coerceGoExpr stateRef moduleName)

-- @inline Main.mark never
-- @inline Main.markAfter never
-- @inline Main.sourceFactory never
module Main where

-- @dependencies: prelude effect console refs arrays foldable-traversable

import Prelude
import Data.Array as Array
import Data.Foldable (for_)
import Effect (Effect)
import Effect.Console (logShow)
import Effect.Ref as Ref
import Effect.Unsafe (unsafePerformEffect)

type Pair = { left :: Int, right :: Int }
type Eight = { a :: Int, b :: Int, c :: Int, d :: Int, e :: Int, f :: Int, g :: Int, h :: Int }
type Wide =
  { a :: Int, b :: Int, c :: Int, d :: Int, e :: Int, f :: Int, g :: Int, h :: Int
  , i :: Int, j :: Int, k :: Int, l :: Int, m :: Int, n :: Int, o :: Int, p :: Int }

pairFields :: Pair -> Array Int
pairFields r = [ r.left, r.right ]

eightFields :: Eight -> Array Int
eightFields r = [ r.a, r.b, r.c, r.d, r.e, r.f, r.g, r.h ]

wideFields :: Wide -> Array Int
wideFields r = [ r.a, r.b, r.c, r.d, r.e, r.f, r.g, r.h, r.i, r.j, r.k, r.l, r.m, r.n, r.o, r.p ]

updatePair :: Int -> Pair -> Pair
updatePair 0 r = r
updatePair n r = updatePair (n - 1) (r { right = r.right + 1 })

updateEight :: Int -> Eight -> Eight
updateEight 0 r = r
updateEight n r = updateEight (n - 1) (r { h = r.h + 1 })

updateWide :: Int -> Wide -> Wide
updateWide 0 r = r
updateWide n r = updateWide (n - 1) (r { p = r.p + 1 })

makeWide :: Int -> Wide
makeWide base =
  { a: base, b: base + 1, c: base + 2, d: base + 3
  , e: base + 4, f: base + 5, g: base + 6, h: base + 7
  , i: base + 8, j: base + 9, k: base + 10, l: base + 11
  , m: base + 12, n: base + 13, o: base + 14, p: base + 15 }

-- The reference boundary supplies a boxed record at runtime. Reading all
-- fields of both the old and new record makes destructive reuse observable.
inspectWide :: Int -> Ref.Ref Wide -> Effect (Array (Array Int))
inspectWide count reference = do
  source <- Ref.read reference
  let partial = updateWide count
  pure [ wideFields source, wideFields (partial source), wideFields (partial source), wideFields source ]

inspectEight :: Int -> Ref.Ref Eight -> Effect (Array (Array Int))
inspectEight count reference = do
  source <- Ref.read reference
  pure [ eightFields source, eightFields (updateEight count source), eightFields source ]

inspectPair :: Int -> Ref.Ref Pair -> Effect (Array (Array Int))
inspectPair count reference = do
  source <- Ref.read reference
  pure [ pairFields source, pairFields (updatePair count source), pairFields source ]

type Mixed = { a :: Int, borrowed :: Array Int, nested :: { flag :: Boolean, x :: Int }, shared :: Ref.Ref Int, tag :: String }

typeChanged :: Pair -> { left :: String, right :: Int }
typeChanged source = source { left = "changed" }

type Trace = Ref.Ref (Array Int)

mark :: Trace -> Int -> Int -> Int
mark trace tag value = unsafePerformEffect do
  Ref.modify_ (\events -> Array.snoc events tag) trace
  pure value

markAfter :: Trace -> Int -> Int -> Int
markAfter trace previous value = unsafePerformEffect do
  Ref.modify_ (\events -> Array.snoc events (200 + previous)) trace
  pure value

sourceFactory :: Trace -> Wide -> Wide
sourceFactory trace source = unsafePerformEffect do
  Ref.modify_ (\events -> Array.snoc events 0) trace
  pure source

main :: Effect Unit
main = do
  inputs <- Ref.new
    [ { count: 0, seed: 19 }, { count: 1, seed: -7 }
    , { count: 2, seed: 2147483647 }, { count: 7, seed: -2147483648 }
    , { count: 31, seed: 2147483630 }, { count: 1000, seed: -19 }
    ]
  cases <- Ref.read inputs
  for_ cases \input -> do
    let wide = makeWide input.seed
    wideRef <- Ref.new wide
    eightRef <- Ref.new { a: wide.a, b: wide.b, c: wide.c, d: wide.d, e: wide.e, f: wide.f, g: wide.g, h: wide.h }
    pairRef <- Ref.new { left: wide.a, right: wide.b }
    inspectWide input.count wideRef >>= logShow
    inspectEight input.count eightRef >>= logShow
    inspectPair input.count pairRef >>= logShow
    original <- Ref.read pairRef
    let changed = typeChanged original
    logShow changed.left
    logShow [ original.left, original.right, changed.right ]
  cell <- Ref.new 10
  mixedRef <- Ref.new { a: 17, borrowed: [ 4, 7, 11 ], nested: { flag: true, x: 29 }, shared: cell, tag: "keep λ" }
  source <- Ref.read mixedRef
  let result = source { a = source.a + 3, nested = source.nested { x = source.nested.x + 1 } }
  Ref.write 77 result.shared
  sourceCell <- Ref.read source.shared
  resultCell <- Ref.read result.shared
  logShow [ source.a, result.a, source.nested.x, result.nested.x, sourceCell, resultCell ]
  logShow [ source.borrowed, result.borrowed ]
  logShow [ source.nested.flag, result.nested.flag ]
  logShow source.tag
  logShow result.tag
  trace <- Ref.new []
  traceInput <- Ref.new (makeWide 5)
  observed <- Ref.read traceInput
  let
    original = sourceFactory trace observed
    first = mark trace 1 (original.p + 1)
    second = markAfter trace first (original.a - 1)
    updated = original { p = first, a = second }
  logShow [ wideFields original, wideFields updated, wideFields original ]
  events <- Ref.read trace
  logShow events

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Archive the completed record update campaign and its independently checked evidence."""
import argparse, difflib, hashlib, json, math, re, runpy, statistics, subprocess, sys
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
WORK = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
ROOT = WORK.parents[2]
COMPILER = ROOT.parent / 'gopurs/gopurs'
OUTPUT = ROOT / 'docs/benchmark-results/2026-11-26-go-record-set.json'
REPORT = ROOT / 'docs/benchmark-results/2026-11-26-go-record-set.md'
SCRIPTS = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
sha = lambda data: hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


def artifact(path, omit=False):
    path = Path(path)
    data = path.read_bytes()
    result = {'sha256': sha(data), 'size_bytes': len(data)}
    if omit:
        result.update(text_omitted='Large generated overlay; reconstruct using the archived proof script, patch and original source hash.',
                      retained_path=str(path))
    else:
        result['text'] = data.decode('utf-8')
    return result


def verify(path, expected):
    if sha(Path(path).read_bytes()) != expected:
        raise ValueError('Hash mismatch: ' + str(path))


def git(*args):
    return subprocess.check_output(['git', '-C', str(COMPILER), *args], text=True)


def check_campaign(campaign):
    pair = runpy.run_path(str(SCRIPTS / 'measure-pair.py'))
    pair['verify_freeze'](campaign['frozen_reference'])
    pair['C']['verify_hashes'](campaign['compiler_snapshot']['files_sha256'])
    for entry in campaign['core_manifest']['plan']:
        verify(entry['manifest'], entry['manifest_sha256'])
        pair['C']['verify_hashes'](entry['payload_sha256'])
    all_cases = campaign['all_campaign']
    for variant, directory in all_cases['workspaces'].items():
        verify(Path(directory) / 'manifest.json', all_cases['manifest_sha256'][variant])
        verify(Path(directory) / 'benchmark', all_cases['executable_sha256'][variant])
    verify(WORK / 'campaign/core/results.json', campaign['core_manifest']['results_sha256'])
    verify(SCRIPTS / 'measure-pair.py', campaign['wrapper_sha256'])
    for variant, times in campaign['matched37_times_us'].items():
        assert len(times) == 37
        combined = dict(campaign['primary_times_us'][variant])
        combined.update({name: row['medians_us'][variant] for name, row in all_cases['all_tests'].items()
                         if name not in combined})
        assert times == combined
        expected = pair['metrics'](times, campaign['frozen_reference']['c37_times_us'])
        for metric, value in expected.items():
            assert math.isclose(value, campaign['aggregates'][variant][metric], rel_tol=1e-12)
    assert campaign['validation']['total_oracles'] == 306
    return {'cases': 37, 'oracles': 306, 'protected_current_files': len(campaign['frozen_reference']['source_sha256']),
            'protected_library_sources': len(campaign['frozen_reference']['library_sources_sha256']),
            'compiler_files': len(campaign['compiler_snapshot']['files_sha256']), 'all_guards_passed': True}


def check_inputs(campaign):
    result = {}
    expected_inputs, expected_stdout = None, None
    counts = None
    for variant in ('before', 'after'):
        directory = WORK / 'proofs' / ('runtime-inputs-' + variant)
        manifest = json.loads((directory / 'manifest.json').read_text())
        assert manifest['validated'] is True
        assert isinstance(manifest['input_variants'], int) and manifest['input_variants'] > 0
        assert isinstance(manifest['oracles'], int) and manifest['oracles'] > 0
        assert manifest['paths'] == ['Apply', 'ffi_conversion', 'forced_fallback']
        assert manifest['oracles'] == len(manifest['paths']) * manifest['input_variants']
        assert manifest['preparation_opaque_calls_per_case'] == {'RecordSetSmall1000': 1, 'RecordSetMedium1000': 1, 'RecordSetLarge1000': 1}
        action_calls = manifest['action_opaque_calls_per_case']
        assert isinstance(action_calls, dict) and len(action_calls) == 3
        assert action_calls == {'RecordSetSmall1000': 2, 'RecordSetMedium1000': 2, 'RecordSetLarge1000': 2}
        assert manifest['action_replayed_with_changing_inputs'] is True
        assert manifest['inputs_immutable'] is True
        assert manifest['binary_sha256'] == campaign['all_campaign']['executable_sha256'][variant]
        verify(Path(manifest['build']) / 'benchmark', manifest['binary_sha256'])
        for name, digest in manifest['generated_source_sha256'].items():
            verify(name, digest)
        verify(directory / 'opaque-override.go', manifest['override_sha256'])
        stdout = (directory / 'stdout.txt').read_text()
        assert stdout == (directory / 'expected.txt').read_text() and not (directory / 'stderr.txt').read_text()
        assert len(stdout.splitlines()) == manifest['oracles']
        inputs = json.loads((directory / 'inputs.json').read_text())
        assert len(inputs) == manifest['input_variants']
        if expected_inputs is not None:
            assert inputs == expected_inputs and stdout == expected_stdout
            assert counts == (manifest['input_variants'], manifest['oracles'])
        expected_inputs, expected_stdout = inputs, stdout
        counts = (manifest['input_variants'], manifest['oracles'])
        result[variant] = manifest
    return {'variants_per_build': counts[0], 'oracles_per_build': counts[1], 'total_oracles': 2 * counts[1],
            'same_inputs_and_outputs': True, 'manifests': result}


def compiler_changes(baseline):
    names = set(git('ls-files', '--cached', '--others', '--exclude-standard').splitlines()) | set(baseline['sources'])
    tracked_before = set(git('ls-tree', '-r', '--name-only', baseline['head']).splitlines())
    before, after, patch = {}, {}, ''
    for name in sorted(names):
        if not (name.startswith(('src/', 'runtime/', 'tools/', 'tests/', 'docs/')) or name in
                ['CHANGELOG.md', 'README.md', 'package.json', 'package-lock.json', 'spago.yaml', 'spago.lock', 'bootstrap-sources.json']):
            continue
        if Path(name).suffix not in {'.purs', '.go', '.js', '.rs', '.mjs', '.md', '.json', '.yaml', '.lock'}:
            continue
        entry = baseline['sources'].get(name)
        old_from_git = False
        if entry:
            old = Path(entry['path']).read_text()
        elif 'source_inventory' in baseline:
            # A complete file snapshot records the actual working tree, including
            # dirty and untracked sources. Never substitute HEAD for that state.
            if name in baseline['source_inventory'] and name not in baseline.get('missing_source_files', []):
                raise ValueError('Missing file from complete baseline snapshot: ' + name)
            old = ''
        elif name in tracked_before:
            # The snapshot intentionally selected only some paths. A tracked
            # file absent from it is not necessarily a newly created file.
            if baseline['status'] != '':
                raise ValueError('Cannot recover an unsnapshotted file from a dirty baseline: ' + name)
            old = git('show', baseline['head'] + ':' + name)
            old_from_git = True
        else:
            old = ''
        current = COMPILER / name
        new = current.read_text() if current.is_file() else ''
        if old == new:
            continue
        if entry:
            before[name] = artifact(entry['path'])
        elif old_from_git:
            before[name] = {'sha256': sha(old.encode()), 'size_bytes': len(old.encode()), 'text': old,
                            'baseline_git_object': baseline['head'] + ':' + name}
        after[name] = artifact(current) if current.is_file() else {'deleted': True}
        patch += ''.join(difflib.unified_diff(old.splitlines(True), new.splitlines(True), fromfile='a/' + name, tofile='b/' + name))
    if not after:
        raise ValueError('Expected compiler changes relative to the frozen baseline')
    return before, after, {'sha256': sha(patch.encode()), 'text': patch}


def check_diagnostics(campaign):
    directory = WORK / 'proofs/isolated-regressions'
    result_path = directory / 'results.json'
    if not result_path.exists():
        return {'performed': False, 'primary_campaign_unchanged': True}
    diagnostics = json.loads(result_path.read_text())
    assert diagnostics['primary_campaign_sha256'] == sha((WORK / 'campaign/results.json').read_bytes())
    assert diagnostics['cases']
    assert diagnostics['oracles_verified'] == 6 * len(diagnostics['cases'])
    comparison = json.loads((directory / 'generated-comparison.json').read_text())
    for key, row in diagnostics['cases'].items():
        assert row['order'] == ['before', 'after', 'after', 'before', 'before', 'after']
        assert row['source_suite'] == ('core' if row['case'] in campaign['primary_times_us']['before'] else 'all')
        for side in ('before', 'after'):
            assert len(row['samples_us'][side]) == 3
            assert statistics.median(row['samples_us'][side]) == row['medians_us'][side]
            verify(directory / (key + '-' + side + '-main.go'), row['main_sha256'][side])
            verify(directory / (key + '-' + side + '-probe'), row['probe_binary_sha256'][side])
        change = 100 * (row['medians_us']['after'] / row['medians_us']['before'] - 1)
        assert math.isclose(change, row['change_percent'], rel_tol=1e-12)
        assert row['increase_over_5_percent_reproduced'] == (change > 5)
        assert all(section['byte_identical'] and section['normalized_identical']
                   for section in comparison[key]['sections'].values())
    return {'performed': True, 'isolated_oracles': diagnostics['oracles_verified'],
            'increases_over_5_percent_reproduced':
            [row['case'] for row in diagnostics['cases'].values() if row['increase_over_5_percent_reproduced']],
            'primary_campaign_unchanged': True}


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--write', action='store_true')
    args = parser.parse_args()
    report_source = REPORT if REPORT.exists() else WORK / 'report.proposed.md'
    if args.write and report_source != REPORT:
        raise ValueError('Write the approved report before the final archive')
    campaign = json.loads((WORK / 'campaign/results.json').read_text())
    baseline = json.loads((WORK / 'compiler-before/manifest.json').read_text())
    checks = check_campaign(campaign)
    inputs = check_inputs(campaign)
    diagnostics = check_diagnostics(campaign)
    final = json.loads((WORK / 'validation-summary.json').read_text())
    if final.get('status') != 'passed':
        raise ValueError('Root-approved validation summary must be passed')
    for check in final.get('required_node_logs', []):
        text = (WORK / check['path']).read_text()
        assert re.search(r'^ℹ pass ' + str(check['passed']) + '$', text, re.M)
        assert re.search(r'^ℹ fail 0$', text, re.M)
    before, after, patch = compiler_changes(baseline)
    proofs = {}
    for path in sorted((WORK / 'proofs').rglob('*')):
        if path.is_file() and path.suffix in {'.json', '.go', '.py', '.mjs', '.js', '.purs', '.md', '.stdout', '.stderr', '.txt', '.patch', '.log'}:
            proofs[str(path.relative_to(WORK / 'proofs'))] = artifact(path)
    logs = {str(path.relative_to(WORK)): artifact(path) for pattern in
            ['validation-logs/*.log', 'logs/*.log', 'after-core/logs/*.log', 'after-all/logs/*.log']
            for path in sorted(WORK.glob(pattern))}
    campaign_files = {str(path.relative_to(WORK)): artifact(path) for path in sorted((WORK / 'campaign').rglob('*'))
                      if path.is_file() and path.name != 'results.json'}
    archive = {
        'date': '2026-11-26', 'archived_at_utc': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), 'campaign': campaign,
        'report': {'path': str(REPORT.relative_to(ROOT)), **artifact(report_source)},
        'compiler': {'baseline_head': baseline['head'], 'baseline_kind': baseline.get('baseline_kind', 'dirty measured snapshot' if baseline['status'] else 'clean measured snapshot'),
                     'head_at_archive': git('rev-parse', 'HEAD').strip(), 'status_at_archive': git('status', '--porcelain'),
                     'baseline_manifest': baseline, 'measured_snapshot': campaign['compiler_snapshot'],
                     'diff_from_baseline': patch, 'before_sources': before, 'changed_sources': after},
        'validation': {'final_summary': final, 'summary_source': artifact(WORK / 'validation-summary.json'),
                       'campaign': campaign['validation'], 'runtime_input_proofs': inputs,
                       'archive_checks': checks, 'diagnostic_checks': diagnostics, 'logs': logs},
        'proofs': {'runtime_inputs_and_collectors': proofs, 'campaign_files': campaign_files,
                   'original_collectors': {name: artifact(ROOT / name) for name in
                       ['bin/benchmark/measure.py', 'bin/benchmark/js-ratios.py', 'bin/benchmark/compare-core.py',
                        'bin/benchmark/publish.py', 'bin/benchmark/validate.py']},
                   'reference_note': 'All 37 C medians are frozen. C/JS sources and historical times are unchanged; neither reference was remeasured.'},
        'preservation_note': 'Raw measurements, manifests, source snapshots, compiler changes and validation evidence are retained in the workspace and archived here. The deleted repository ratio catalogue is not recreated.'}
    serialized = json.dumps(archive, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + '\n'
    if args.write:
        if OUTPUT.exists():
            raise ValueError('Refusing to overwrite an archive')
        OUTPUT.write_text(serialized)
    print(json.dumps({'written': args.write, 'path': str(OUTPUT), 'bytes': len(serialized.encode()),
                      'sha256': sha(serialized.encode()), 'compiler_changed_files': list(after),
                      'checks': checks, 'runtime_oracles': inputs['total_oracles']}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

                      'benchmarks_executed': False}, indent=2))
else:

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Separate AB/BA/AB diagnostics for primary increases, preserving primary samples."""
from pathlib import Path
import argparse, difflib, hashlib, json, math, os, re, runpy, statistics, subprocess, sys
from datetime import datetime, timezone
sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
ROOT = Path('/Users/0x1/Documents/htdocs/altbak.pub')
WORK = ROOT / 'var/benchmark/go-record-set-20261126'
PROOF = WORK / 'proofs/isolated-regressions'
HELPERS = runpy.run_path(str(Path(__file__).with_name('compare-generated.py')))
sha = lambda path: hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
primary = WORK / 'campaign/results.json'
primary_sha = sha(primary)
report = json.loads(primary.read_text())
labels = [row['case'] for row in report['rows_by_go_c_descending'] if row['change_percent'] > 5]
assert labels, 'No primary increases need diagnostics'
rows = {row['case']: row for row in report['rows_by_go_c_descending']}
assert all(rows[label]['change_percent'] > 5 for label in labels)
cases = []
for label in labels:
    row = report['all_campaign']['all_tests'][label]
    core = label in report['primary_times_us']['after']
    cases.append({'key': re.sub(r'[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]+', '-', label), 'label': label,
                  'module': row['module'].replace('.', '_'),
                  'getter': 'Get_' + row['module'].replace('.', '_') + ('_act' if core else '_prepare'),
                  'expected': row['expected'], 'prepare': not core, 'source_suite': 'core' if core else 'all',
                  'primary_change_percent': rows[label]['change_percent']})
parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
parser.add_argument('--execute', action='store_true')
args = parser.parse_args()
if not args.execute:
    print(json.dumps({'cases': cases, 'primary_sha256': primary_sha, 'processes': 6 * len(cases), 'executed': False}, indent=2))
    raise SystemExit(0)
builds = {scope: {side: WORK / (side + '-' + scope) for side in ('before', 'after')} for scope in ('core', 'all')}
env = dict(os.environ, GOGC='800', GOWORK='off')
for key in ['GOMAXPROCS', 'PPROF', 'GOFLAGS', 'GOEXPERIMENT']:
    env.pop(key, None)
PROOF.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
(PROOF / 'inputs.json').write_text(json.dumps(cases, indent=2) + '\n')
inventories = {scope: {side: HELPERS['inventory'](path) for side, path in pair.items()} for scope, pair in builds.items()}
originals = {scope: {side: inventory['provenance'] for side, inventory in pair.items()} for scope, pair in inventories.items()}
commands, sources, comparisons = {}, {}, {}


def normalize(body):
    # Canonicalize only generated package aliases/runtime spelling and trailing
    # whitespace; preserve calls, literals, arithmetic, local names and order.
    body = re.sub(r'\b(?:g[0-9a-f]{6})\.', 'package.', body.decode())
    body = re.sub(r'\br_\.', 'r.', body)
    return '\n'.join(line.rstrip() for line in body.splitlines()).strip() + '\n'


# First compare target module and original harness sections, before building probes.
for case in cases:
    key = case['key']
    selected = {'Bench.go', 'Bench_ffi.go', 'Effect_Console.go', 'Effect_Console_ffi.go', case['module'] + '.go'}
    extracted = {side: {name: body for name, body in inventory['sections'].items() if Path(name).name in selected}
                 for side, inventory in inventories[case['source_suite']].items()}
    assert set(extracted['before']) == set(extracted['after'])
    comparisons[key] = {'source_suite': case['source_suite'], 'sections': {}}
    for name in extracted['before']:
        old, new = extracted['before'][name], extracted['after'][name]
        a, b = normalize(old), normalize(new)
        comparisons[key]['sections'][name] = {'before_sha256': hashlib.sha256(old).hexdigest(),
                                              'after_sha256': hashlib.sha256(new).hexdigest(),
                                              'byte_identical': old == new, 'normalized_identical': a == b,
                                              'before': old.decode(), 'after': new.decode(),
                                              'normalized_diff': ''.join(difflib.unified_diff(a.splitlines(True), b.splitlines(True)))}
    assert all(item['normalized_identical'] for item in comparisons[key]['sections'].values()), ('Changed target/harness code', key)
(PROOF / 'generated-comparison.json').write_text(json.dumps(comparisons, indent=2) + '\n')
print('All selected target modules and harness sections are unchanged after normalization.', flush=True)

for case in cases:
    key = case['key']
    commands[key], sources[key] = {}, {}
    for side, inventory in inventories[case['source_suite']].items():
        owner = lambda name: [str(Path(path).parent) for path, body in inventory['sections'].items()
                              if re.search(rb'func ' + name.encode() + rb'\(', body)]
        action, bench, console = owner(case['getter']), owner('Call_Bench_runBench'), owner('Get_Effect_Console_log')
        assert len(action) == len(bench) == len(console) == 1
        packages = sorted(set(action + bench + console))
        aliases = {name: 'p' + str(i) for i, name in enumerate(packages)}
        imports = '; '.join(aliases[name] + ' "gopurs/output/' + name + '"' for name in packages)
        act = aliases[action[0]] + '.' + case['getter'] + '()'
        if case['prepare']:
            act = 'r.Apply(' + act + ',r.Value{})'
        main = f'''package main
import(r "gopurs/output/gopurs_runtime"; {imports})
func main(){{
 act:={act}
 for i:=0;i<3;i++{{if value:=r.Apply(act,r.Value{{}});value.Type!=r.TypeInt||value.IntVal!={case['expected']}{{panic("invalid global warmup result")}}}}
 describe:=r.Apply({aliases[console[0]]}.Get_Effect_Console_log(),r.Str("{case['label']}"))
 r.Apply({aliases[bench[0]]}.Call_Bench_runBench(describe,act),r.Value{{}})
}}
'''
        source = PROOF / (key + '-' + side + '-main.go')
        source.write_text(main)
        sources[key][side] = sha(source)
        command = ['go', 'build', '-pgo=off', '-o', str(PROOF / (key + '-' + side + '-probe')), str(source)]
        process = subprocess.run(command, cwd=builds[case['source_suite']][side] / 'output', env=env, text=True, capture_output=True)
        (PROOF / (key + '-' + side + '-build.stdout')).write_text(process.stdout)
        (PROOF / (key + '-' + side + '-build.stderr')).write_text(process.stderr)
        process.check_returncode()
        assert not process.stderr
        commands[key][side] = command
        print('Built', key, side, flush=True)

# All probe builds complete before the first timed process.
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / 'bin/benchmark'))
from validate import ROW
order = ['before', 'after', 'after', 'before', 'before', 'after']
results = {}
for case in cases:
    key = case['key']
    samples, runs = {'before': [], 'after': []}, []
    for index, side in enumerate(order, 1):
        process = subprocess.run([str(PROOF / (key + '-' + side + '-probe'))],
                                 cwd=builds[case['source_suite']][side] / 'output', env=env,
                                 text=True, capture_output=True, timeout=60)
        stem = f'{key}-{index}-{side}'
        (PROOF / (stem + '.stdout')).write_text(process.stdout)
        (PROOF / (stem + '.stderr')).write_text(process.stderr)
        process.check_returncode()
        assert not process.stderr
        values = ROW.findall(process.stdout)
        assert len(values) == 1 and process.stdout.count('(Test)') == 1
        label, value, elapsed = values[0]
        assert label.strip() == case['label'] and value.strip() == str(case['expected'])
        elapsed = float(elapsed)
        assert math.isfinite(elapsed) and elapsed > 0
        batches = [int(n) for n in re.findall(r'^Batch iterations: (\d+)$', process.stdout, re.M)]
        assert len(batches) == 1 and 0 < batches[0] <= 16777216 and not batches[0] & (batches[0] - 1)
        samples[side].append(elapsed)
        runs.append({'variant': side, 'time_us': elapsed, 'batch_iterations': batches[0],
                     'stdout': process.stdout, 'stderr': process.stderr})
        print(stem, elapsed, 'us', flush=True)
    medians = {side: statistics.median(values) for side, values in samples.items()}
    change = 100 * (medians['after'] / medians['before'] - 1)
    results[key] = {'case': case['label'], 'source_suite': case['source_suite'], 'expected': case['expected'],
                    'original_builds': originals[case['source_suite']], 'commands': commands[key],
                    'main_sha256': sources[key], 'probe_binary_sha256': {side: sha(PROOF / (key + '-' + side + '-probe')) for side in samples},
                    'order': order, 'samples_us': samples, 'medians_us': medians, 'change_percent': change,
                    'primary_change_percent': case['primary_change_percent'], 'increase_over_5_percent_reproduced': change > 5,
                    'runs': runs}
for scope, pair in builds.items():
    for side, path in pair.items():
        assert originals[scope][side] == HELPERS['inventory'](path)['provenance']
assert sha(primary) == primary_sha
result = {'measured_at_utc': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
          'scope': 'Separate diagnostics only; original primary samples and aggregates remain unchanged',
          'protocol': 'AB/BA/AB for each case; actual getters and unchanged Bench.runBench; 3 global warmups then calibration and minimum of ten batches; all builds finished before timing',
          'GOGC': '800', 'GOMAXPROCS': 'default', 'host_isolated': False,
          'source_comparison': 'generated-comparison.json', 'script_sha256': sha(__file__),
          'primary_campaign_sha256': primary_sha, 'cases': results, 'oracles_verified': 6 * len(cases),
          'original_generated_sources_and_binaries_unchanged': True}
(PROOF / 'results.json').write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + '\n')
print(json.dumps({key: {name: row[name] for name in ['case', 'source_suite', 'samples_us', 'medians_us', 'change_percent', 'increase_over_5_percent_reproduced']}
                  for key, row in results.items()}, indent=2))

from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path('/Users/0x1/Documents/htdocs/altbak.pub')
COMPILER = ROOT.parent / 'gopurs/gopurs'
OLD = ROOT / 'var/benchmark/go-indexed-fold-20261126'
WORK = ROOT / 'var/benchmark/go-record-set-20261126'

if (WORK / 'compiler-before/manifest.json').exists():
